question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The erroneous spelling is '**Crystle**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Crystle**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Crystal**'. • It means 'a regular shape that some mineral substances form when they become solid'. (ठोस हो जाने पर बनी धातुओं की सुनिश्‍चित आकृति; रवा) • *Example: salt **crystals**...* • Thus, the correct answer is** Option 2.** **Correct Answer:__**** ***Crystle.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Cubicle**: a small room that is made by separating off part of a larger room. (बड़े कमरे में विभाजन कर बनाया छोटा कमरा; कक्षक) • **Crust**: the hard part on the outside of a piece of bread, a pie, etc. (डबलरोटी आदि की बाहरी कड़ी सतह; पपड़ी) • **Cube**: a solid shape that has six equal square sides. (छह समान पार्श्‍वों वाला ठोस पिंड; घनाकृति) 34:Tb76, The correct answer is 'wake me up'.
